_readme: Edit this file to recalibrate. 'calibration_points' need >=4 entries (used to compute the matrix). 'validation_points' are OPTIONAL extra markers, measured but NOT used in the fit, used only to check accuracy in mm. pixel = [x, y] read off calib_frame.jpg. real_world = [x, y] in mm, measured from the robot arm's origin, using the same sign convention the arm uses.
